description: Scheduled, published, and first-available times for releases a delivery monitor must classify. first_published_at is the earliest published_at among the period's revisions. first_available_at is the earliest available_at. source_delay_seconds is first_published_at minus scheduled_at. availability_delay_seconds is first_available_at minus first_published_at.

checks.name: on time without a value
checks.reason: A release with a null value still arrived on time.

checks.name: late at the source
checks.reason: The delay is the source's; the provider took its usual 70 seconds.

checks.name: late at the provider
checks.reason: The source published on time. The first version a customer could retrieve was the next day's revision, not the initial release.
